phases.objective: Implement an unmounted async execution engine that consumes the canonical synthetic protocol through the durable Tenant facade, preserves parent/child ordering, and finalizes Run and Operation state without Provider dispatch.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Parent-Aware Async Execution Engine Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A verified protocol is prepared through the durable facade, every item produces contiguous prepared/result/readback evidence, Run and Operation advance through readback_pending and reconciling, one reconciliation is appended, and both reach an outcome-bound terminal state while Provider dispatch remains disabled.
steps: Require the canonical durable Tenant facade and canonical non-provider synthetic adapter.
Verify the synthetic execution protocol digest and safety identity.
Validate exact protocol, preparation, run, lease, plan-item, hash, path, size, and file-type bindings before durable preparation.
Prepare the durable plan-item and run parents through the facade.
Append a deterministic prepared event for each item.
Execute the exact synthetic non-provider mutation and append its result receipt.
Read the synthetic item state and append deterministic readback evidence.
Advance Run and Operation to readback_pending through checkpoint CAS and canonical transition policy.
Advance Run and Operation to reconciling.
Append one reconciliation bound to protocol, preparation, journal, readback, and item accounting digests.
Finalize Run and Operation to completed, failed/blocked, or unknown_outcome according to the reconciliation result.
Return a secret-free Tenant-safe internal result while remaining unmounted.
assertions: Engine construction performs no database, mutation, route, worker, or Provider call.
Protocol or plan-item binding drift fails before prepareExecution.
The public facade never exposes the raw repository transition method.
Every item has exactly three globally contiguous child events in prepared, result, readback order.
Run transitions use exact checkpoint digests and Operation transitions use exact versions and current states.
Reconciliation is appended only after both Run and Operation are reconciling.
Canonical applied and safely skipped outcomes are covered with the real synthetic adapter.
No route, server, migration, live database, Hostinger, Provider, main, or Production mutation occurs.

phases.objective: Add durable authority and enablement stores, dedicated worker/fixed dispatch certification, crash-safe restart reconciliation, and a separately authorized mount path.
blockers: Durable authority and one-shot enablement stores are not implemented.
Dedicated worker and fixed dispatch certification are not complete.
Interrupted execution restart reconciliation is not implemented.
No route or worker mount authorization exists.

phases.objective: Resume partial prepared/result/readback sequences after a fresh durable read without duplicate writes or blind retry.
This engine uses only the canonical synthetic memory adapter and performs no live Tenant or Provider canary.
Production database access, Provider dispatch, runtime mounting, and Production promotion remain separately authorized and blocked.
